meta.captured_ideal: Template files define the bare minimum of a file type within the repository.
meta.struct_description: This struct file defines the rules, prompts, and descriptions all '*_template.json' files within the repository must conform to. Each template is expected to contain the minimum content and structure any file of that template type will be constructed ontop of.
meta.category_description: Templates contain the minimum content and structure files of that template type will be constructed of.

base_audit.template_type_scripts: Templates for file types that are python files must also be a python file.
base_audit.template_type_other: Templates for file types that are not scripts must be a .json file.
